signal_or_failure: Chartered capital fully subscribed within three weeks of the books opening
magnitude: 2000000 dollars at 50 par by several thousand persons
what_it_demonstrated: The licence could be funded and civic institutions put money into it
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: That depositors would come, that the banking clause would be tolerated, or who any subscriber was
notes: First validation signal of the stage; the subscriber list is asserted to survive but is not printed.

signal_or_failure: A banking office opened and advertised its counter hours in a daily paper
magnitude: One office; 10:00 to 15:00; a named cashier, Henry Remsen
what_it_demonstrated: The charter's banking clause was exercised publicly and within the year
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: Any transaction, balance, customer or profit
evidence_class: RESTATED with a transmitted contemporary print
notes: The first transaction cycle the corpus documents end to end.

signal_or_failure: First dividend paid six months after opening
what_it_demonstrated: In the carrier's telling the banking operation covered its costs at once
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: That the rate was material, that it came from banking rather than water, or that anyone outside counted it
notes: §S.5: no independent count exists behind any corporate aggregate in the window.

signal_or_failure: Selected as a depositary for Government funds withdrawn from the second United States Bank
magnitude: amount UNKNOWN; one of several banks
what_it_demonstrated: A national authority treated the house as safe
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: That private depositors agreed, or how much was placed
notes: The strongest external endorsement the Manhattan line receives anywhere in the corpus.

signal_or_failure: The licensed purpose reached measurable scale
what_it_demonstrated: Water actually was supplied under the charter that was really about banking
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: That the service satisfied anybody (the carrier concedes it did not) or that it was profitable
notes: The licensed purpose ends at Croton c. 1842 with no accounting of either line.

signal_or_failure: A powerful newspaper editor wagered his own specie on the bank's notes
magnitude: 5-dollar notes to ladies; 5 dollars each; at 21 Ann Street between 11 and 1
what_it_demonstrated: Third-party evidence that the notes were thought redeemable during a general suspension
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: That the notes traded at par, that holders were unharmed, or that the editor was neutral
evidence_class: CONTEMPORARY OBSERVATION transmitted through a 1913 carrier
notes: The only voice from 1837 that the bank did not originate - though the bank chose to print it.

signal_or_failure: The bank survived its original 21-year term and was re-chartered with local money
magnitude: 28 subscribers; 5 original directors; a cashier at 1500
what_it_demonstrated: Political durability and a willing local capital base
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: That the franchise was desirable rather than merely renewed; no price of the new stock prints
notes: U.010 governs which act is called the beginning.

signal_or_failure: First declared dividend then a repeatable annual series
magnitude: 6 per cent declared; 12 per cent for 1849 above the city's 22 dividend-paying banks
what_it_demonstrated: A repeatable return to shareholders announced on a fixed calendar
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: That the return came from banking rather than from accumulated surplus, or that the ranking was externally verified
notes: The corpus's closest analogue to a scalable validated business.

signal_or_failure: Admission as an original member of the New York Clearing House Association
magnitude: No. 2 in seniority as the bank itself states it
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: Settlement volume or any independent confirmation of the rank

signal_or_failure: A rival institution's printed roll records the older bank's charter date and capital
what_it_demonstrated: Survival and standing attested by a competing publisher
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: Any relationship to, or identity with, the modern registrant
notes: The single best instance of independence in this corpus - and it attests a date not a virtue.

signal_or_failure: Declined to suspend specie while the city did; stood alone as a cash payer
magnitude: Specie 327282 (Oct 3) to 666277 (Dec 5); 12 of about 50 banks held more at the first date
what_it_demonstrated: A testable public solvency signal: weekly statements were the validation medium of the era
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: That customers were unharmed, that refusing deposit interest was wise, or that the printed one-to-thirty-six ratio is coherent
notes: The strongest validation signal for any ancestry in the window.

signal_or_failure: A banking house was solicited by a Congressional sub-committee and answered in print
magnitude: one printed letter; a partner testified separately
what_it_demonstrated: Political standing sufficient to be invited
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: That its self-description was correct: the document is advocacy, not performance
notes: The only Morgan-side validation datum available at any tier.

signal_or_failure: A New York bank's security appears in a third-party securities table
what_it_demonstrated: The Chase line existed as an institution with a listed and quoted security
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: What the number means; whether the table's unit is dollars per share
notes: The only non-company-originated in-window datum on the Chase line; U.002 and U.011 apply.

signal_or_failure: The Chase line's parent declares ownership and resources in its own advertisement
what_it_demonstrated: That a New York bank was marketing foreign-banking service into the China trade with a stated parent
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: Anything audited: this is advertisement copy with OCR-exposed digits
notes: Self-reported; the 1936 twin is the same source and adds nothing (U.002).
